target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew accepts A. sanguinea as native from South Texas into northeastern Mexico, and TPWD treats it as a South Texas species. This pass did not lock three exact project target-zone counties from high-confidence county sources.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need three exact target-zone county records.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Regional South Texas occurrence is not enough for the 3-county PASS rule.

morphology.look_here_first: Red prickly-poppy stands out by large rose, pink, red, lavender, or occasionally pale flowers above glaucous prickly foliage; yellow latex and prickly buds/capsules confirm the genus.
